correctness.rationale: Residue-fibre orthogonality with q^9 lifts is exact for every finite length-two chain ring. Cofactor map images rank 0,1,3 only; invertible fibres have exactly two opposite solutions, and odd-order phases cannot cancel. Rank-zero and rank-one fibres reduce to explicitly nonzero finite-field rank-one-cone and SL2 Kloosterman character sums. Nonunit frequencies reduce to exact known finite-field determinant-phase Fourier sums, nonzero by the cyclotomic mod-(1-zeta_p) argument. Counting residues yields the claimed integer rank. Independent FFT checks for Z/9, F3[t]/t², fields 2 and3 corroborate selected subcases, not replace proof.

value.rationale: The determinant is the canonical cubic relative invariant on 3-by-3 matrices. The full Fourier-zero distribution of its graph over length-two rings gives an exact, natural convolution rank and reveals a sharp square-class/noncancellation mechanism (all rank-two residues vanish, half of full-rank residues survive) with a nontrivial asymptotic density 1/2. This is not a routine consequence of scalar determinant fibre counts or finite-field transform values alone.
